cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've cleared a coat hook like you. Making room for me again, then. Was the flat too quiet while I was away?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My coat's drying in the kitchen. Did you miss me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, keep the hooks clear. You first: did you hear keys and hope they were mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I rang the landline to hear your voice. I was never really asking about the gas bill.
